answer: The kernel schedule is applied in sable and saffron exposes each instalment. A payout is split which means 44% arrives at settlement and the rest over 12 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. An attacker as a result cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 2748 identities would post 1494 proofs and burn roughly 58 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
